symbols.name: Retryer
symbols.summary: Provides retry functionality to handle transient failures by retrying an operation a specified number of times with configurable delays.

symbols.name: Retryer(int, TimeSpan, bool, bool, ILogger, IProgress)
symbols.summary: Initializes a new instance of the Retryer class with the specified retry settings.

syntax.content: public Retryer(int maxRetries, TimeSpan delay, bool useExponentialBackoff = false, bool handleErrors = false, ILogger logger = null, IProgress progress = null)

parameters.description: The maximum number of retry attempts.
The initial delay between retry attempts.
If true, increases the delay exponentially with each retry attempt. Defaults to false.
If true, catches and logs exceptions from the action; otherwise, throws them. Defaults to false.
An optional logger to log errors if handleErrors is true. Defaults to null.
An optional progress reporter for retry operations. Defaults to null.
